title: Disentangling Speaker Traits for Deepfake Source Verification via Chebyshev Polynomial and Riemannian Metric Learning
abstract: arXiv:2603.21875v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Speech deepfake source verification systems aims to determine whether two synthetic speech utterances originate from the same source generator, often assuming that the resulting source embeddings are independent of speaker traits. However, this assumption remains unverified. In this paper, we first investigate the impact of speaker factors on source verification. We propose a speaker-disentangled metric learning (SDML) framework incorporating two novel loss functions. The first leverages Chebyshev polynomial to mitigate gradient instability during disentanglement optimization. The second projects source and speaker embeddings into hyperbolic space, leveraging Riemannian metric distances to reduce speaker information and learn more discriminative source features. translated_title: 通过切比雪夫多项式和黎曼度量学习解缠说话人特征用于深度伪造来源验证
translated_abstract: 语音深度伪造来源验证系统旨在确定两条合成语音话语是否源自同一生成器，通常假设得到的来源嵌入与说话人特征无关。然而，这一假设尚未得到验证。在本文中，我们首先研究了说话人因素对来源验证的影响。我们提出了一种说话人解缠度量学习（SDML）框架，其中包含两个新颖的损失函数。第一个利用切比雪夫多项式来缓解解缠优化过程中的梯度不稳定性。第二个将来源和说话人嵌入投影到双曲空间，利用黎曼度量距离来减少说话人信息并学习更具判别性的来源特征。在MLAAD基准上的实验结果，在四个新提出的专为来源-说话人解缠场景设计的协议下进行评估，证明了其有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种说话人解缠度量学习框架，通过切比雪夫多项式和黎曼度量学习有效分离说话人特征，提升了深度伪造来源验证的准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a speaker-disentangled metric learning framework that effectively separates speaker traits via Chebyshev polynomials and Riemannian metric learning, improving deepfake source verification accuracy.
